_comment: Committed sample: placeholders and comments only. Copy your real values into redact.config.local.json (git-ignored). Keys starting with an underscore are ignored. Layering, lowest to highest: built-in defaults, this sample, local file, -ConfigPath, parameters. Arrays and scalars replace lower layers; categories merges key by key. Built-in allowlists (endpoints, GUIDs, IPs, SIDs) cannot be removed.
_internalDomains_comment: Your AD and UPN domains, for example the forest root and the email domain. Subdomains are included. Used for host.domain names, DC= distinguished names and the residual check.

netbiosDomains._comment: NetBIOS (pre-Windows 2000) domain name and its FQDN. Both get one domain token, so CONTOSO\user and user@ad.contoso.example correlate.

hostPatterns._comment: Desktop naming pattern. Matches shorter than minLength are ignored; without a digit class minLength must be 4 or more.

_hostPatterns_comment: Regexes for workstation, laptop, server, VM and Linux host names. Matched case-insensitively as whole words. Nested quantifiers such as (a+)+ are rejected.
_hostList_comment: Exact host names that do not follow a pattern. One-off servers, appliances, lab machines.
_resourcePrefixes_comment: Azure resource group and resource naming prefixes. A bare name starting with one becomes [res-NN]; names starting with rg- become [rg-NN].
_usernames_comment: Explicit user or service account names to map, for example service accounts that appear without a domain.

extraTerms.label: proj
extraTerms._comment: A project or program name. The label (letters and digits) becomes the token type: [term-proj-01].

extraTerms.label: contract
extraTerms._comment: A contract number or part-number prefix.

_extraTerms_comment: Project or program names, contract numbers, site or building names, part-number prefixes. Matched case-insensitively as whole words.
_guidAllowlist_comment: GUIDs to keep verbatim, for example Intune setting-definition, CSP or ADMX GUIDs. Never list tenant, subscription, object or device IDs. Bulk lists go in guid-allowlist.txt.
_publicHostAllowlist_comment: Extra public endpoints to keep readable. An entry like *.example.net matches subdomains on a label boundary; a plain entry matches exactly.
_publicDomains_comment: Extra public email domains (kept in addresses; the local part is still mapped). Subdomains are included.
_ipAllowlist_comment: IP addresses to keep verbatim, for example a public DNS resolver.
_ipMode_comment: Classify (private -> ip-priv, public -> ip-pub), KeepPrivate (private addresses stay readable) or Keep (IPv4 and IPv6 off).
_pathMode_comment: UserOnly (profile folder names), Full (every folder except well-known system folders) or Keep (profile path rule off).
_sidKeepRid_comment: true keeps the RID: S-1-5-21-[sid-dom-NN]-512. false replaces the whole SID with [sid-dom-NN].
_categories_comment: Per-category on/off, merged key by key over lower layers. Keys: guid, sid, upn, tenant, fqdn, host, ipv4, ipv6, mac, azure-resource, azure-host, thumbprint, unc, profile-path, domain-user, person, extra-term. Secret categories cannot be disabled.
_secretNames_comment: Extra key/property names whose values are secrets (S04), added to the built-in list. Example: ["badge_pin"].
_nonSecretNames_comment: Names that contain a secret-like word but are not secret (S04 deny-list), added to the built-in list. Compared case-insensitively on the exact name. Example: ["KeyRotationDays"].
_deviceSerialPatterns_comment: Regexes for device serial numbers that appear without a Serial label, for example a laptop vendor's serial format. Replaced with [serial-NN]. Same safety checks as hostPatterns.
